comments.author: sanket95droid
comments.body: Mage Space keeps characters consistent across generations which is key for avatars. artbreeder works too but its more for morphing than building a cohesive look.

replies.author: LongjumpingRelease82
replies.body:
yeah the consistency across generations aspect is important. i actually stumbled upon Genies bc their blog talked about that - [https://genies.com/blog/genies-developer-roadmap-what-to-expect-and-how-you-can-help-shape-it](https://genies.com/blog/genies-developer-roadmap-what-to-expect-and-how-you-can-help-shape-it)

Will take a look at Mage Space & artbreeder. ty!
